SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
[FI] "An adult is the form of a youth that has been 
betrayed."

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] - Osamu Dazai.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
[FI] This is the Kousaka household, located somewhere 
in Chiba.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
[FI] In this residence, worried maidens assemble, 
seeking answers from the master of life, every night.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] Now then, I wonder who tonight's guest will be...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] So you have come.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] --! An ox...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] What...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] No, you need not mind me. It's nothing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] By the way, what exactly are you?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I'm Kousaka Daisuke... You may address me as 
Sensei while we're here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Sensei... So that's the temporary form bestowed 
upon you in this present age.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Well, let's go with that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] As for myself... Let's see, please call me Kuroneko.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Kuroneko? Is this a joke?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Surely I would not jest on such a matter.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] ...For some reason, my soul is bound to a frail human 
vessel.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Furthermore, how I choose to refer to myself is 
irrelevant.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Have you... had a weird dream?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] What a rude ox. How about you, why are you in 
the form of a human?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...*gasp*!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Don't tell me you're a Minotaur...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] What?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Ugh... That battle was concluded in my favor. And 
yet, you appear before me once more, learning 
nothing from it...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] It seems like the divine will that dwells in your 
subconscious, he still bears a grudge from that 
defeat.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...What are you talking about?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] It's futile to deceive me. I understand what's going 
on.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] I do not plan on deceiving you.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I am only here to conduct life consultations for 
people like you. Say whatever that's on your mind.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Someone like you is trying to counsel me in the 
ways of life?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] You must be joking.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I could say the same to you. After all, haven't I 
experienced more of what life has to offer?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Such a dull speech. It's as if you're from some 
ancient era.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] --Ah... No wonder.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] You were corrupted by the impurities of this era, 
so you have forgotten about your mission.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Recall, Minotaur... In your previous existence--

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] That has nothing to do with what we're discussing 
right now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] ...It seems there's a strong seal placed upon your 
memories. How pitiful.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] In that case, I shall enlighten you about the truth.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] In this world, a war has been raging between the 
heavens and the netherworld for countless millennia... 
even to this day.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] If it goes on like this, a calamity beyond human 
comprehension will soon befall on this planet.
[FI] W-What is this girl talking about...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] What is this battle between the heavens and 
netherworld about?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It’s the holy war that mortals cannot see.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] You would know this if the memories of your past 
life have awakened.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] This holy war has had a negative impact on the 
world... from environmental disasters to increased 
criminal activity.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Surely you must've noticed this?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] H-Hmm... Certainly, the crime rates in recent years 
have been steadily increasing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Then you must have understood. Until this war ends, 
we shall never experience true peace.
[FI] No... I don’t understand anything at all...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] So what does this have to do with you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] If I am defeated, this whole world will be 
destroyed.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=33]W-What!?[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] The fate of the world transcribed onto the Destiny 
Record...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] As it was written, my victory was absolute...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] But, right now, Belphegor's magic has had a major 
effect on the world.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] That magic is so powerful... it is re-writing the 
Destiny Record.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] To restore the world to its original state, I must 
repel her...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] H-Huh... Is it difficult to achieve victory in that 
conflict?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Yes... Indeed.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] And yet, simply achieving victory would not solve 
everything.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] What happens to the world after the holy war, 
surely you understand?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] There is no way I would understand...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] As expected.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] The world after the holy war--

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Imagine the aftermath of my victory in the holy 
war, if the world is in ruins, it would be meaningless.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Why...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Because... there would be many people in grief.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Who would these grieving people be?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] The vanquished... or rather, those who were unable 
to attain victory.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] There can be no winners without losers... Isn't that 
the way it is?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Yes. However, I don't believe that the victorious 
should be able to inflict further harm upon the 
defeated.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] And finally, the most difficult issue at hand, this war 
must not be revealed to the masses.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Who might that be?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Those who lost themselves in the heat of battle, 
fools who no longer possess memories of their past 
selves.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...This holy war seems rather complex.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Indeed. If I could use my true power, it would've 
been resolved easily.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Unfortunately, you are what you are now. Hence, 
you have to come up with solutions given the 
circumstances.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] You must've been working towards that, am I 
right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] O-Of course...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] However, as I said, it is difficult. It is frustrating how 
these human vessels do not move the way you 
desire.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] I see...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] According to your theory, I have no memories of 
my past life.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] As such, I am completely ignorant of that holy war. 
However, there is at least one thing I can impart to 
you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] And what might that be?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] The world in legends is always in a continuous cycle 
of destruction and resurrection.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Hence, you should use that unique imagination of 
yours to work out a solution to revive the world.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] No matter what kind of world it is, Dusk is followed 
by darkness and eventually reaches dawn.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] What is more important than anything, is what you 
want to do after that.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] That said, have you thought about what it might 
be?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Th-That...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] ?  ...Why are you embarrassed?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] N-No reason. Please don’t stare at me so much.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] What exactly is she thinking about...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Fufu... fufufu. Reshaping the world with my own two 
hands... Isn't that interesting.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Fine, I will change it, with my hands...!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yes, that's the spirit. Make this your ideal world.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] The divine may just be observers, but humans 
originally wield such power.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] That sounds like nonsense you can only hear in a 
dream...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] But, I don't dislike it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Perhaps, this conversation might change the 
contents of the Destiny Record.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] When the time comes, look forward to whatever 
new role you will play.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Is she gone?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Today's moral lesson!!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=33]Life is an individual's legend!![/font_size]
[FI] Now that I think about it--
[FI] What role that girl plan on having me do...

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
[FI] --As such, Daisuke has guided the path of another 
lost maiden. Let us meet on another moonlit night.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Honey... Did you understand anything she said?

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
[FI] What are you saying, Dear? That was a love 
consultation, without a doubt.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] What...?  How can you tell that was a love 
consultation?

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] *sigh*... You sure are dense at these things.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Mmm.
